enchantments.tooltip: Assassinate +8: +8 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.
Quality Assassinate +1: +1 Quality bonus to the DC of character's Assassinate attempts.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +15 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Deception +5: +5 Enhancement bonus to hit and +8 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
